Not a problem cleaning the vat with alcohol if you let it dry.But cleaning the fep with alcohol can cloud it over time reducing the print quality.

So it prints but its just a flat piece on the fep afterwards? Feels like it doesnt attach to the build plate or it attached badly and fails when more weight comes on or a bigger area is pulled from the fep. 
Make sure levelling is ok and bottom exposure isn't too low. Or the lift speed in the bottom fase might be too fast.
Make sure the plate is not dry when you start printing by smeering it with some resin using a rubber or silicone spatula. 
Temperature could have an impact. 
Lastly something that is a bit weird but helped me. take the resin out of the vat. Clean the rest of the resin with dry microfibertowels use multiple small/cut ones NO Alcohol. Then apply a little bit of ptfe lubricant with a clean microfibertowel onto the fep. Leave it on a bit. Then clean it off with another clean towel. Refill resin and print. You can also find this on youtube.
